extracted.name: Kentucky Wonder Beans
extracted.description: This Kentucky wonder beans recipe features heirloom green pole beans simmered with bacon, garlic, salt, and black pepper to bring out the best flavor.
ingredient_lines: 4 cups trimmed heirloom green beans (such as Kentucky Wonder Beans)
1 teaspoon olive oil, or as needed
1 pinch coarsely ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Pour about 1 inch water into a large saucepan. Add green beans, bacon, olive oil, garlic, sea salt, and black pepper; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium, cover, and cook until beans are tender, 7 to 10 minutes.
